notes: CRITICAL: This registry is the single source of truth for document filenames.
ALL agents MUST consult this registry before writing foundation documents.
Never generate filenames by slugifying document titles—always use the filename field.
If an agent generates a document not in this registry, it is an error—report it.
Document titles may differ from filenames (e.g., title='Guardrails', filename='guardrails.md')—this is OK and expected.
When validating foundation output, check BOTH filename correctness and title consistency against this registry.
